welcome.title: Welcome to KnYC
welcome.body: Import a project you want to understand. KnYC turns it into steps, and you rebuild it one step at a time, with real checks and an AI guide that knows the code.
welcome.loopCaption: Then the next step, until the project is yours

ai.title: Connect an AI
ai.body: KnYC uses your own AI to plan paths, write lessons and explain failing checks. Nothing goes through a KnYC server.
ai.missing: Claude Code isn’t installed. Install it, sign in once in a terminal, then check again.
ai.loggedOut: Claude Code v{{version}} is installed but not logged in. Open a terminal, run claude, then type /login, and check again.
ai.modelsHint: Sensible defaults are set; you can change them any time in Settings.

toolchains.title: Toolchains
toolchains.body: The projects you import run on your machine. Here is what KnYC found.
toolchains.notBlocking: Nothing here blocks you: each project is checked again when you import it.

import.title: Import a project
import.intro: Your original folder is never modified. KnYC rebuilds it in a separate workspace.
import.sourcePlaceholder: Pick the project you want to understand
import.workspaceHint: Where you will rebuild the project, step by step.
import.sentTitle: What will be sent to your AI
import.planNote: With Claude Code there is no per-call cost: this uses part of your Claude plan. Estimated for a standard path of about {{steps}} steps.
import.privacy: Secrets never leave your machine: secret files are skipped and lines that look like secrets are blanked out.
import.desktopOnly: The analysis runs in the KnYC desktop app.
